# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VOLUME_IMBALANCE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the first 30-minute opening range shows disproportionately high downside volume, price tends to continue lower as early-day selling pressure overwhelms buyers. This edge exists because institutional algorithmic selling often clusters at the open, creating persistent downward pressure that retail buying cannot immediately absorb.

## Mechanism

Calculate opening range (OR) high/low from first two 5-minute bars (09:30-09:55 ET). Sum volume of bars closing below OR midpoint (down volume) and above OR midpoint (up volume). Enter short at 09:55 bar close if: down volume >= 1.5 * up volume AND 09:55 close <= OR low + 0.1*(OR high - OR low). Exit: stop at OR high (chart-stop), target at 1.5× risk or trailing stop of 10% ATR from highest high since entry. Regime filters: VIX < 20, time 09:30-10:30 ET, avoid FOMC/CPI/news, OR width < 0.5% of SPY.
